description:
Delete the Beadwork worker runtime modules. No wrap, no shim, no tmux fallback.

## Kill files (typical)

- `src/orchestrator.ts`
- `src/tmux.ts`
- `src/worktree.ts` managed lifecycle
- `src/registry.ts` as execution truth
- `src/actions/delegate.ts`, `landing.ts`, `workers.ts`
- `src/worker-diagnostics.ts` if worker-only
- process marker / runtime dir helpers only used by workers
- e2e tmux/current-branch swarm scripts; replace later in D, but they must not be the published path

Then remove WorkerRuntime/tmux fields from types.ts and leftover config types (the goal-state issue kept them for compile).

## Background

Publication still waits on phase D e2e. This issue is the code deletion on the cutover branch. Do not leave a worker-shaped façade.

## Success criteria

- No production import of tmux.ts.
- `rg beadwork_delegate` only in changelog/migration docs.
- Package typechecks without orchestrator.ts.
- Attribution helpers remain.

## Test plan

- Removal regressions listed in the living spec.
- `npm run typecheck` -w beadwork.

## Considerations

Blocked until `/bw run` no longer calls the supervisor and worker tools are gone, otherwise HEAD cannot typecheck/test. Keep git history; do not "deprecate" in place.
title: Delete tmux, orchestrator, worktree, registry, and worker action modules
